All path variants sum identically (0.1+0.15+0.25+1.0 = 0.1+0.4+1.0 = 1.5), so there is no incentive to rush or delay the door toggle, and no positive self-loops exist, keeping rewards dense across the four milestones (key, second key step, door open, box) but strictly bounded at 1.5. key_lost (an event) is correctly unused and covered by per-state else self-loops in all five states; door_open regressions (toggle shut, never relocked) need no explicit regression here and are absorbed by u3's else self-loop while the agent reopens the unlocked door. Format matches the paper style (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES, (s,guard)->s' transitions, (s,guard,s')->r rewards); all labeled transitions have rewards and all rewards correspond to labeled transitions. No blocking issues found.
